name: has_phd
description: Founder holds a PhD or doctorate
expression: lambda founder: any('phd' in e.get('degree', '').lower() or 'doctor' in e.get('degree', '').lower() for e in founder.get('educations', []))

name: prior_ipo
description: Founder was involved in a prior IPO

name: has_experience_in_industry
description: Founder has at least one job in the industry
expression: lambda founder: any(job.get('industry', '').lower() == (founder.get('industry', '').lower() if founder.get('industry') else '') for job in founder.get('jobs', []))

name: education_qs_rank_high
description: Founder has education with QS rank 10 or better
expression: lambda founder: any(parse_qs(e.get('qs_ranking', '')) <= 10 for e in founder.get('educations', []))

name: has_exited
description: Founder has IPO or acquisition event

name: has_multiple_jobs
description: Founder has more than one job experience

name: has_job_duration_over_3_years
description: Founder has at least one job lasting over 3 years
expression: lambda founder: any(parse_duration(job.get('duration', '')) > 3 for job in founder.get('jobs', []))

name: industry_in_target_list
description: Founder’s industry is in a predefined target list

name: has_startup_experience
description: Founder has been a co-founder or founder in at least one startup
expression: lambda founder: any('co-founder' in job.get('role', '').lower() or 'founder' in job.get('role', '').lower() for job in founder.get('jobs', []))

name: education_field_relevant
description: Founder’s education field is relevant to tech or business
expression: lambda founder: any(e.get('field', '').lower() in ['computer science', 'business', 'engineering', 'management', 'information technology'] for e in founder.get('educations', []))

name: industry_experience_in_target
description: Founder’s work experience is in a target industry
expression: lambda founder: any(job.get('industry', '').lower() in ['software development', 'healthcare', 'fintech', 'biotech', 'education', 'media'] for job in founder.get('jobs', []))

name: has_mba_or_higher
description: Founder has at least an MBA degree
expression: lambda founder: any('mba' in e.get('degree', '').lower() or 'master' in e.get('degree', '').lower() for e in founder.get('educations', []))

name: has_experience_in_target_industries
description: Founder has prior experience in target industries
expression: lambda founder: any(job.get('industry', '').lower() in ['software development', 'healthcare', 'fintech', 'biotech', 'education', 'media'] for job in founder.get('jobs', []))

name: has_experience_in_target_roles
description: Founder has held roles like CEO, CTO, co-founder
expression: lambda founder: any('co-founder' in job.get('role', '').lower() or 'ceo' in job.get('role', '').lower() or 'cto' in job.get('role', '').lower() for job in founder.get('jobs', []))

name: has_high_qs_ranking_education
description: Founder has education with QS ranking <= 50
expression: lambda founder: any(parse_qs(e.get('qs_ranking', '')) <= 50 for e in founder.get('educations', []))
